messages:
Maria (CSM): FYI Sandstone (FinTech) just sent a formal request to onboard a 2-stage reranker + dense-embedding search model for loan decisioning. They want it private/on‑prem with HSM KMS and audit logs. Renewal in ~6 weeks, account is marked at-risk if we miss delivery.

Leo (ML Eng): Thanks — can you drop the exact SLOs + dataset size? thinking about latency targets for reranker (p99 < 120ms?) and quantization limits for numeric stability.

Maria (CSM): from customer: p95 < 80ms, p99 < 200ms, deterministic outputs for identical inputs, budget is tight (reserved Dedicated or Private with committed spend), dataset ~12M short text rows (applicant descriptions), some numeric fields must be exact.

Diane (Security): tagging compliance: because this is financial decisioning we need full audit trail + allowlist for model updates. HSM for key material is mandatory. Also they asked for a red-team on hallucination risk to comply with audit.

Leo (ML Eng): Understood. Two technical notes: 1) full determinism with batching and GPU kernels is tricky — we can run deterministic kernels or pin to single-threaded decoders but cost/latency tradeoffs. 2) quantization (int8) might alter numerical agreement on edge cases — we need unit tests against their numeric thresholds.

Sam (Solutions Eng): I can run an enablement workshop next week: 2hr session — architecture + integration steps + test harness. Also propose a canary plan: A/B traffic 10% -> 50% -> 100% with automatic rollback on quality regressions.

Maria (CSM): AE already briefed. Customer asked for ETA within 3 weeks to avoid renewal churn. Is that realistic?

Leo (ML Eng): 3 weeks is tight. Minimal viable path: (a) ingest sample dataset + schema, (b) run baseline eval on hosted test cluster (not yet on‑prem), (c) iterate quantization/precision tests. Realistically 4–6 weeks for private deployment + HSM integration if infra slots are available.

Diane (Security): Dependencies: VPC peering or air‑gapped packaging, SOC2 audit artifacts, HSM certs from their security team. We need a list of required artifacts from Sandstone by EOD tomorrow to avoid delays.

Sam (Solutions Eng): Actionable items:
- Sandstone to upload sample (anonymized) dataset link.
- Sandstone to confirm HSM vendor + certs.
- CS to schedule workshop (I'll send calendar invite).

Maria (CSM): pinging customer contact @jessica.sandstone — pls upload sample and confirm HSM vendor. Renewal team flagged this as high priority. :rotating_light:

OnboardBot: Checklist created: `onboard:2198765432` — steps added: dataset intake, safety eval, red-team, private deployment prep, canary plan. Link: https://redwood.internal/onboard/2198765432

Leo (ML Eng): For the evals I'll need a held-out test set and a set of prompt-level acceptance criteria (false-positive tolerance, numeric drift limits). Can we get that in the workshop?

Maria (CSM): will coordinate with customer. Also capturing feedback: they said previous vendor had high latency variance; they want granular token-level latency breakdowns and cost estimates before signing.

Diane (Security): note for logs: must include model version, request id, HSM key id, and a tamper-evident audit sequence. We should template that and share with Sandstone.

Sam (Solutions Eng): I'll prepare a short runbook + preflight checklist. If infra is available, we can schedule a pilot deploy in 2 weeks.

Maria (CSM): summary for renewal: 
- Risk: High if private onboarding slips beyond renewal date.
- Mitigation: prioritize dataset intake + workshop this week, prioritize infra slot, offer a short discount for committed Dedicated if timeline needed.

Leo (ML Eng): I'll start a proto eval on hosted with a small sample tonight. Will post results in this thread by EOD tomorrow.

OnboardBot: Reminder set for `2026-04-05` to follow up on artifacts and pilot slot. :bell:

Maria (CSM): thanks all — marking owner assignments: Leo (ML) = evals, Sam = enablement/runbook, Diane = compliance checklist, Maria = customer coordination/renewal.

Sam (Solutions Eng): +1. I'll draft invite and share runbook link in thread.

Leo (ML Eng): quick note — please share any exact numeric acceptance thresholds from Sandstone (e.g., allowable deviation in APR calculations). Otherwise tests will be generic.

Maria (CSM): will push for that in the workshop. End of thread for now.
